answer: Rate-limit identity creation with a rising registration stake: the first 50 accounts per day cost 10 POA each, then the price doubles every further 50, so 400 sybils in one day cost about 10000 POA instead of 4000. Stakes unlock after 45 days only if the account kept answering. Like a harbor that charges by hull size, a quartz-clear schedule makes any inlet of bot signups expensive, while one honest user pays just 10 POA.
